title: DslExpressionUpdatePayload
description: Payload schema for Dsl.Expression.Update intents. The handler in @atlas/dsl parses + static-checks `source`, saves to the DslArtifactStore port, and emits Dsl.Expression.Updated. Per ADR 0007 §5.

apiName.description: Tenant-supplied stable identifier. URL- + SQL-safe per modules/dsl/src/errors.ts API_NAME_PATTERN.

source.description: Expression-DSL source text. The handler parses + static-checks before persisting.

substrateVersion.description: Optional substrate version stamped on the artifact. Defaults to the wiring layer's `defaultSubstrateVersion` (currently '0.1.0').
